actionType.title: Action Type
actionType.description: Identifies the type of optimization action recommended for the line item.

adUnit.title: Ad Unit
adUnit.description: Ad unit associated with the evaluated line item.

advertiser.title: Advertiser
advertiser.description: Advertiser associated with the evaluated line item.

applyStatus.title: Apply Status
applyStatus.description: Indicates whether the recommendation has been applied. In the current POC, this remains pending human approval and does not modify campaign records.

averageDailyImpressions.title: Average Daily Impressions
averageDailyImpressions.description: Average number of impressions delivered per day across the available historical period for the line item.

cpm.title: CPM
cpm.description: Historical cost per thousand impressions calculated for the line item from the available delivery data.

cpmVersusBenchmarkPercentage.title: CPM Versus Benchmark Percentage
cpmVersusBenchmarkPercentage.description: Percentage difference between the line item's CPM and the portfolio median CPM used as the optimization benchmark.

creative.title: Creative
creative.description: Creative associated with the evaluated line item.

ctrPercentage.title: CTR Percentage
ctrPercentage.description: Historical click-through rate percentage calculated from clicks and impressions for the line item.

ctrVersusBenchmarkPercentage.title: CTR Versus Benchmark Percentage
ctrVersusBenchmarkPercentage.description: Percentage difference between the line item's CTR and the portfolio median CTR benchmark.

deliverySignal.title: Delivery Signal
deliverySignal.description: Indicates the line item's delivery condition relative to its applicable goal, when an absolute goal is available.

engagementSignal.title: Engagement Signal
engagementSignal.description: Indicates whether the line item's CTR is strong or weak relative to the portfolio benchmark.

expectedImpact.title: Expected Impact
expectedImpact.description: Describes the expected delivery, engagement, supply, or efficiency benefit of the recommended optimization action.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable summary explaining the optimization assessment, recommendation, and important supporting metrics.

fillRatePercentage.title: Fill Rate Percentage
fillRatePercentage.description: Historical percentage of ad requests that were successfully filled for the line item.

fillRateVersusBenchmarkPercentage.title: Fill Rate Versus Benchmark Percentage
fillRateVersusBenchmarkPercentage.description: Percentage difference between the line item's fill rate and the portfolio median fill-rate benchmark.

goalType.title: Goal Type
goalType.description: Goal type configured for the evaluated line item, such as a lifetime or percentage-based goal.

goalUnits.title: Goal Units
goalUnits.description: Absolute goal units available for the line item when the source data provides an absolute goal.

historicalAdRequests.title: Historical Ad Requests
historicalAdRequests.description: Total ad requests recorded for the line item across the historical reporting period.

historicalClicks.title: Historical Clicks
historicalClicks.description: Total clicks recorded for the line item across the historical reporting period.

historicalImpressions.title: Historical Impressions
historicalImpressions.description: Total ad-server impressions recorded for the line item across the historical reporting period.

historicalRevenue.title: Historical Revenue
historicalRevenue.description: Total ad-server revenue recorded for the line item across the historical reporting period.

historicalUnfilledImpressions.title: Historical Unfilled Impressions
historicalUnfilledImpressions.description: Total impressions that were requested but remained unfilled during the historical reporting period.

humanApprovalRequired.title: Human Approval Required
humanApprovalRequired.description: Indicates whether human approval is required before the recommended optimization can be applied.

lineItemId.title: Line Item ID
lineItemId.description: Unique identifier of the line item that was evaluated by the optimization engine.

lineItemType.title: Line Item Type
lineItemType.description: Type of line item associated with the evaluated campaign.

optimizationHealth.title: Optimization Health
optimizationHealth.description: Overall optimization health classification based on delivery, engagement, supply, yield, and viewability signals.

optimizationUrgency.title: Optimization Urgency
optimizationUrgency.description: Priority level indicating how urgently the identified optimization issue should be addressed.

portfolioMedianCpm.title: Portfolio Median CPM
portfolioMedianCpm.description: Median CPM calculated across the available portfolio line items and used as the CPM benchmark.

portfolioMedianCtrPercentage.title: Portfolio Median CTR Percentage
portfolioMedianCtrPercentage.description: Median CTR percentage calculated across the available portfolio line items and used as the engagement benchmark.

portfolioMedianFillRatePercentage.title: Portfolio Median Fill Rate Percentage
portfolioMedianFillRatePercentage.description: Median fill-rate percentage calculated across the available portfolio line items and used as the supply benchmark.

portfolioMedianViewabilityPercentage.title: Portfolio Median Viewability Percentage
portfolioMedianViewabilityPercentage.description: Median viewability percentage calculated across the available portfolio line items and used as the viewability benchmark.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Explains the data-driven reason why the recommended optimization action was selected.

recent7DayAverageImpressions.title: Recent 7 Day Average Impressions
recent7DayAverageImpressions.description: Average daily impressions delivered during the most recent seven historical reporting days available for the line item.

recentDeliveryTrendPercentage.title: Recent Delivery Trend Percentage
recentDeliveryTrendPercentage.description: Percentage change in recent delivery performance compared with the preceding historical period used by the optimization engine.

recommendedAction.title: Recommended Action
recommendedAction.description: Human-readable optimization recommendation generated from the line item's delivery and performance signals.

status.title: Status
status.description: Execution status returned by the optimization action, indicating whether the optimization analysis completed successfully or encountered an issue.

success.title: Success
success.description: Indicates whether the optimization analysis completed successfully for the requested line item.

supplySignal.title: Supply Signal
supplySignal.description: Indicates whether the line item's fill performance is strong or weak relative to the portfolio benchmark.

viewabilityPercentage.title: Viewability Percentage
viewabilityPercentage.description: Historical percentage of measurable impressions that were viewable for the line item.

viewabilitySignal.title: Viewability Signal
viewabilitySignal.description: Indicates whether the line item's viewability performance is strong or weak relative to the portfolio benchmark.

viewabilityVersusBenchmarkPercentage.title: Viewability Versus Benchmark Percentage
viewabilityVersusBenchmarkPercentage.description: Percentage difference between the line item's viewability and the portfolio median viewability benchmark.

yieldSignal.title: Yield Signal
yieldSignal.description: Indicates whether the line item's CPM/yield performance is strong or weak relative to the portfolio benchmark.
